top_signals.title: Uganda in Final Stages of Oil Production
top_signals.summary: After nearly two decades of discussions Uganda is preparing to become an oil producing nation before the end of its financial year in June 2027. This comes as East Africa works to become more energy self sufficient amid a disruption in oil flows from the Middle East conflict. Kristina Kasebayo, Head of Compliance at the Uganda National Oil Company explaind to Bloomberg Television Chief Africa Anchor and Correspondent Jennifer Zabasajja in a fireside chat at Africa Energy Week. (Source: Bloomberg)

Trafficking takes many forms, including sexual exploitation, labour exploitation, forced criminality, begging and forced marriage.
